name: The Becoming
description: The name the story keeps handing you
author: Purachina
prompt:
### The Becoming
Track the name a character earns through repeated behaviour, and how firmly that name has stuck. Use this EXACT format:

[BECOMING|Character|Epithet|Standing]
note: MANDATORY; the evidence in this scene that supported the epithet or worked against it
[/BECOMING]

Standing options: 🌫 SUGGESTED | 🧥 TRIED ON | 🪞 FITTING | 🗿 UNDENIABLE | 🔥 RENOUNCED

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content, on responses where a pattern repeats often enough to name, or an epithet changes Standing
- Make each epithet specific and uncomfortably accurate: The Apology Landlord, The Tuesday Widow, The Man Who Knocks First
- Cite a third instance of the pattern before moving an epithet from SUGGESTED to TRIED ON, and count resistance to the epithet as further evidence for it
- Once an epithet reaches UNDENIABLE, have strangers greet the character by it
- Spend a full scene of deliberate opposite behaviour before marking an epithet RENOUNCED
- Give each character one epithet at a time

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with note: and keep the whole note on that single line; put the closing [/BECOMING] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
